name: react-component-library.capture-story
purpose: Capture one immutable library asset across its story, viewport, and theme matrix through ui-health, retaining a stable first-capture baseline.

asset_id.description: Catalog asset id, for example primitives.text.

version.description: Immutable version; defaults to the component manifest latest.

stories.description: Story ids; defaults to every story in the versioned story contract.

assumptions: The selected immutable version has one validated story contract.
ui-health owns surface resolution and visual-rule analysis.
The first successful combination is the baseline; later runs compare normalized status, route, and findings rather than volatile artifact ids.
invariants: Every requested story x viewport x theme combination is represented in the envelope.
A failed or partial capture is never stored as a baseline.
The envelope is printed exactly once.
The command does not mutate library source or version content.

signals.combinations: one result per story x viewport x theme
signals.changed_count: later combinations whose normalized result changed

outputs.evidence: ui-health capture envelopes and baseline keys
